name: large
_patch_note: patch 0 = full image. Measured receptive field is 72 px (16 blocks) / 104 px (24 blocks); a 64 px crop is smaller than that, so cropped training would feed the network zero-padding it never sees at inference.
_amp_note: amp:true assumes a GPU with tensor cores. Benchmark first: python train.py --config configs/large.json --benchmark
